Los plugins que dependen de Dataform [mod_dataform] son:

*   Dataform view [mod_dataformembed]
*   Dataform view access [block_dataformaccessview]
*   Dataform notification [block_dataformnotification]
*   Restriction by dataform content [availability_dataformcontent]
*   Dataform entry access [block_dataformaccessentry]
*   Dataform field access [block_dataformaccessfield]
*   Dataform view [block_dataform_view]
